title: dogfood: object-designer-field-reorder cases time out at 5000 ms on a loaded merge-group shard and kick unrelated PRs from the queue
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: a flake that removed an unrelated PR from the merge queue. Dedupe: `object-designer-field-reorder` / `field-reorder dogfood`; no open card (the test's origin card #21790 is closed).

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:devx (dogfood test infrastructure) · tooling

## What happened

Merge-group run https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44054298746 (head `2d3165fd`, job "Dogfood Regression Gate (2/3)") failed only in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/object-designer-field-reorder.dogfood.test.ts`: 2 of its 5 cases (lines 98 and 104) hit `Test timed out in 5000ms`. The file took 34 s in total on that shard. The PR in that group (#34666) does not touch the object designer, metadata publish or the dogfood harness, so it was removed from the queue at 09:39Z for a failure it did not cause.

## What is wanted

Find why the two cases exceed the 5000 ms default on a loaded shard (a real slow path in publish/read-back, or a case that needs a declared timeout because it boots more than the default allows), and fix the root: either the slow path or an explicit, justified per-case timeout. ⛔ Not a skip or a retry wrapper.

## Re-check

`gh api repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/jobs/133939893383/logs | grep -c 'object-designer-field-reorder.*timed out\|Test timed out in 5000ms'`
